PlayerKarteaConfigCsvDAO

class PlayerKarteaConfigCsvDAO[source]

Bases: BaseCsvDAO[PlayerKarteaConfig]

DAO of PlayerKarteaConfig in CSV.

Each player has a file {player_id}_{sanitized_name}_kartea_config.csv with a single row; the configuration key is the player id. The CRUD lives in BaseCsvDAO; this class only builds the references (player, session, phase and level).

Attributes:
modeltype, class attribute

Model for player configuration in the Kartea game.

suffixstr, class attribute

“kartea_config”.

single_rowbool, class attribute

True: one row per player, keyed by the player id.

configsdict[int, PlayerKarteaConfig]

Configurations by player id (the cache dictionary).

player_daoPlayerCsvDAO

DAO for accessing Player objects.

session_daoPlayerKarteaSessionCsvDAO

DAO for accessing PlayerKarteaSession objects.

phase_daoKarteaPhaseCsvDAO

DAO for accessing KarteaPhase objects.

level_daoKarteaPhaseLevelCsvDAO

DAO for accessing KarteaPhaseLevel objects (shares phase_dao).

See also

KarteaPhaseService

Lists of phases and levels.

Notes

Creating the DAO creates the auxiliary DAOs and then loads the configurations.
